note: Scored by Claude Opus 5 inside a working session on 2026-08-27, taking the institutionalist stance from packages/core/src/delphi/panel.ts. One panelist, one round, all 40 countries and all nine dimensions, 360 cells. This is not a panel: the median is one opinion and the IQR is zero. It is one stance argued consistently, which is what makes it useful and also what makes it partial. The institutionalist prior weights formal institutions and durable organisations, and it is deliberately sceptical of capability that rests on individuals compensating for institutional failure, so it will read low on countries with large informal capability and high on countries with durable state capacity. Scored against the D47 frame, which is built from all 40 benchmark countries; there is no reference set. Coordination and Trust carry no indicator score for any country after D23 and D44 retired the WGI composites and the homicide rate, so for those 80 cells this estimate becomes the published blendedScore with no indicator evidence behind it. Treat those two dimensions as one analyst's judgement until a second and third panelist from different vendors have scored them. Replace with a multi-vendor gateway run before publishing. One caveat on range: for Coordination and Trust, where no indicator score exists for any country, the estimates run roughly 16 to 88 rather than using the full 0-100 span, so the bottom of those two distributions is compressed relative to a dimension the indicators actually anchor.
